title: Small talk before take-off
instruction: Watch the awkward travel small talk. Notice the offers, then suggest a more natural approach

video.title: POV you’re the cute girl at the airport

items.prompt: Which details tell you they are travelling by plane?
items.hint: Listen for the take-off and the boarding door
items.answer: They mention a smooth take-off and closing the boarding door

items.prompt: What does one passenger offer to help with?
items.hint: Watch the bag and listen to the first question
items.answer: He offers to help put her bag away

items.prompt: What does a passenger ask her to do if he falls asleep?
items.hint: He gives her permission to interrupt his sleep
items.answer: He asks her to wake him up or nudge him

items.prompt: How would you start a friendly conversation without making a stranger uncomfortable?
items.hint: Keep it brief, use the travel situation and leave room for them not to chat
items.answer: Example: Is this your first time visiting Dublin? No worries if you’d rather relax
